coverageContext: Complete 388-term TPMI Han Chinese model for the broad hereditary hemolytic-anemia code group (282, D55–D58), not any specific molecular subtype. Development and evaluation report the same code list. Evaluation included only 98 cases among 18,170 participants; AUROC about 0.826 includes sex, age, array and ten principal components and is not genetic-only or GA performance. No European evaluation is deposited, so European reference ranks are withheld. This polygenic sum is not a test for thalassemia, sickle-cell disease, G6PD deficiency, a pathogenic gene variant, carrier status, reproductive risk or medication-related hemolysis. It neither replaces the separate variant-interpretation layers nor guides transfusion or drug decisions.
